title: Online Mistake Detection in Instruction-Conditioned Procedural Video
abstract: arXiv:2611.25567v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An assistant monitoring a person performing a procedure is most useful when it can detect mistakes while there is still time to recover. This requires judging actions against task instructions as the video unfolds, identifying the attempted step, locating it in time, and assessing its execution. Existing online detectors do not use the instruction text, while instruction-conditioned methods operate offline. In this paper, we study online, instruction-conditioned mistake detection in egocentric videos. Using only observed video, task instructions, and prior predictions, our model identifies and localizes completed action attempts and classifies them as correct, modified, slip, corrections, or additions; omitted steps are determined after the video ends. We compare a modular pipeline, with separate step identification, temporal localization, and execution verification, to a joint model that predicts all outputs in a single step. To suppo

translated_title: 指令条件化程序性视频中的在线错误检测
translated_abstract: 一个监控他人执行程序的智能助手，如果能够在还有时间挽回错误时就检测到错误，将是最有用的。这要求在视频播放过程中，根据任务指令来判断动作，识别所尝试的步骤、对其进行时间定位并评估其执行情况。现有的在线检测器不使用指令文本，而基于指令条件化的方法则是离线运行的。在本文中，我们研究了自我中心（第一视角）视频中的在线、指令条件化错误检测。仅使用已观测的视频、任务指令和先前的预测，我们的模型能够识别并定位已完成的动作尝试，并将其分类为正确、修改、失误、纠正或添加；被遗漏的步骤则在视频结束后确定。我们将具有独立步骤识别、时间定位和执行验证功能的模块化流水线，与在单一步骤中预测所有输出的联合模型进行了比较。为了支持（此处的摘要内容被截断）
tldr: 本文研究了自我中心视频中在线的、基于指令条件化的错误检测，模型仅利用已观测视频、任务指令和先前的预测，实时识别并定位已完成的动作尝试并将其分类为正确、修改、失误、纠正或添加，同时比较了模块化流水线与联合模型两种方案。
en_tdlr: This paper studies online, instruction-conditioned mistake detection in egocentric procedural videos, where a model uses only observed video, task instructions, and prior predictions to identify, localize, and classify completed action attempts as correct, modified, slip, corrections, or additions, comparing a modular pipeline against a joint single-step model.
